verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ha. Mim

verses.ar: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
verses.en: By the Scripture that maketh plain

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.en: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning

verses.ar: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.en: Whereon every wise command is made clear

verses.ar: أَمۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
verses.en: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending

verses.ar: رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.en: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower

verses.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure

verses.ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

verses.ar: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ يَلۡعَبُونَ
verses.en: Nay, but they play in doubt

verses.ar: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
verses.en: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

verses.ar: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
verses.en: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment

verses.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.en: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers

verses.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
verses.en: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمࣱ مَّجۡنُونٌ
verses.en: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.en: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief)

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.en: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish

verses.ar: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger

verses.ar: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
verses.en: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

verses.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
verses.en: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant

verses.ar: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
verses.en: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death

verses.ar: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
verses.en: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
verses.en: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk

verses.ar: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.en: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed

verses.ar: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
verses.en: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host

verses.ar: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
verses.en: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind

verses.ar: وَزُرُوعࣲ وَمَقَامࣲ كَرِيمࣲ‏
verses.en: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

verses.ar: وَنَعۡمَةࣲ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
verses.en: And pleasant things wherein they took delight

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk

verses.ar: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.en: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
verses.en: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom

verses.ar: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.en: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤࣱ اْ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.en: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying

verses.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.en: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again

verses.ar: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth

verses.ar: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
verses.en: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.en: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play

verses.ar: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.en: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not

verses.ar: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.en: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful

verses.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.en: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum

verses.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
verses.en: The food of the sinner

verses.ar: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
verses.en: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

verses.ar: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
verses.en: As the seething of boiling water

verses.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.en: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
verses.en: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water

verses.ar: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
verses.en: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
verses.en: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured

verses.ar: فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
verses.en: Amid gardens and watersprings

verses.ar: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسࣲ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.en: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
verses.en: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

verses.ar: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: They call therein for every fruit in safety

verses.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.en: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell

verses.ar: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
verses.en: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph

verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed

verses.ar: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
verses.en: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting
